Affects projections whose local shard has n < 2048 and k >= 2048 (for example the down projection of small models, or fused qkv shards at larger tensor-parallel sizes). The condition is evaluated on the fused, TP-sharded weight with n = output_size_per_partition and k = input_size_per_partition: row-parallel layers (o_proj, down_proj) shard k and keep n full, column-parallel layers (qkv_proj, gate_up_proj) shard n and keep k full. Qwen2.5-7B therefore never takes the atomic path at TP=1 or TP=2 (the TP=2 o_proj shard is n=3584, k=1792) and does at TP=4 through qkv_proj (n=1152, k=3584); Qwen2.5-1.5B takes it through down_proj at TP=1, 2 and 4 (n=1536 with k=8960, 4480 and 2240). The recorded 7B TP=2 differences (3 of 12 comparisons, top-5 values only) are not attributed to this guard. The Marlin kernel is JIT compiled, at this pin and at the July one: marlin_utils.py:49 imports gptq_marlin_gemm from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.gptq_marlin, whose load_jit call at python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization/gptq_marlin.py:21-25 names gemm/marlin/gptq_marlin.cuh, which includes this file. path_description: Exllama 4-bit GEMM: GPTQ, AutoGPTQ and compressed-tensors wNa16 linear layers when ExllamaLinearKernel is selected. path_description: MoE wNa16 CUDA kernel (moe_wna16_gemm_kernel): the grid splits K over blockIdx.z (gridDim.z = size_k / BLOCK_SIZE_K). Each block computes the partial dot product of its K slice for up to BLOCK_SIZE_M (token, expert-slot) rows, scales it by the routing weight when mul_topk_weight, rounds it to the activation type with Dtype::float2num and atomicAdds it into output[token_index * size_n + offset_n], a per-(token, expert-slot) row that moe_wna16_gemm zeroes on entry. The K-slice partials of one output element therefore accumulate in arrival order; with three or more slices the stored value depends on block scheduling. Experts of one token write different rows and do not collide. The kernel source is byte-identical to the July pin. What changed is the dispatch: it is now selected only inside dispatch_fused_moe_kernel (renamed from invoke_fused_moe_kernel), which calls should_moe_wna16_use_cuda when the caller passes an int8/int4 wNa16 config with a group size, and only fused_experts_impl and the dots3 vision MoE helper call that function. The wNa16 quantisation methods no longer reach it: the GPTQ and AWQ moe_wna16 methods (MoeWNA16Method.apply, AutoAWQMoEMethod.apply) and compressed-tensors wNa16 MoE (CompressedTensorsWNA16MoEMethod.apply) all build a modular kernel through the WNA16 backend oracle, whose TRITON backend is TritonWNA16Experts and calls invoke_fused_moe_wna16_triton_kernel only, and whose other backends are Marlin, Humming, FlashInfer TRT-LLM, CPU, XPU or emulation.
